full_judgment: "Section 96- pre-emption of agricultural land by co-sharer or by contiguing land holder. In these cases the pre-emptees resisted the pre-emption cases on two grounds-(1) the pre-emptees after purchase of the case land have duly separated the jama of the holding and (2) the area in which the case land is situated has already been included by the Government in a municipality, thereby taking it out of the purview of section 96 of the SAT Act, 1950. The trial court accepted the contention of the pre-emptees and refused pre-emption. In revision, the High Court Division set aside the judgements of the Courts below rejecting the pleas of the pre-emptees."
